claims.quote: Epileptic encephalopathy, caused by mutations in the dynamin-1 (DNM1; NM_004408) gene, is a newly identified neurologic disorder in children.
patients carrying pathogenic variants in the GTPase or middle domains present with epileptic encephalopathy
patients carrying pathogenic variants in the GTPase or middle domains present with epileptic encephalopathy and severe neurodevelopmental symptoms
